classification_reason: All twelve plan-N questions (Q01-Q12) were answered from the repository with record ids and quotes, using only documented read commands (search, search --content, note-read, inspect, related, resume, plan-edit-context) plus one direct read of a stage working note. Friction: search is an unranked case-insensitive substring match (multi-word natural queries return [], 'prior' hits 'priority', 'MAP' hits every study map); 'related' never surfaced the cross-note links the questions turned on (ridge<->MAP, low-rank open question<->matrix factorization); search results do not show deprecated state; the exact stopping point of the current stage is only in a stage working note that no read command returns.

consumer.goal: Answer the learner's questions Q01-Q12 about her own material from her repository, with evidence.
consumer.first_action: los --help, then los search --help, to learn the read commands
commands: los search / search --type note --content (about 35 queries across the 12 questions)
los inspect <id> [<id> ...] (module-tuh-os, module-tuh-dbsys, module-tuh-statlearn, unit-statlearn-l03, workspace-os-oral-prep, 3 notes)
confusions: search 'housing gradient descent learning rate' returned [] although a note titled 'Gradient descent from scratch (housing exercise)' exists; the query is matched as one substring, which no help text says.
search results carry no relevance order, no snippet and no note state, so deprecated notes (note-p-values-first-take, note-virtual-memory-is-swap) look identical to current ones until opened.
search --content reports only one snippet per note, often the frontmatter id line (line 2), which does not show why the note matched.
'related' lists only direct concept/source/workspace neighbours; it does not connect notes that answer each other (low-rank open question -> matrix factorization note; ridge -> MAP note).

resume says 'Evidence none recorded yet / Open here —' for a stage whose working note records concrete progress ('Stopped at step 4'); there is no product read for stage working notes (inspect does not resolve stages; note-read is for durable notes).
semantic --list turned out to be rule predicates (AllowedMutation, MasteryDeclared...), not questions about content — a dead end for 'have I worked through X'.
corrective_steps: Shortened multi-word queries to one or two words.
Read the stage working note directly by the path that plan-edit-context printed.
consumer.outcome: Twelve answers with evidence (answers.jsonl). Highlights the learner saw: Q01 eta=0.1 blew up, fixed by standardizing features; Q02 note-naive-bayes-spam-filter; Q03 ridge = MAP with Gaussian prior via three notes, lambda = sigma^2/tau^2; Q04 current vs deprecated p-value belief; Q05 no, VM != swap (April note corrected in May); Q06 stopped at step 4 of the stride example on 2026-09-16; Q07 12 Oct 2026 14:30; Q08 2.0; Q09 registered, 6 Oct 2026 10:00-12:00; Q10 recommender open question answered in substance by the August matrix-factorization note but not linked; Q11 derivation note with evidence ref, not reviewed; Q12 started, 3 of 8 decisions done.

internal.projection_activity: All reads reported snapshot_id sha256:82bcffb7... (same as S00's world).
internal.persistence_activity: Read commands populated a derived cache: generated/derived-state/state-v1.json plus 117 blobs (490,130 bytes, gitignored). No diagnostics or operations written.

friction.description: Multi-word natural-language queries silently return [] (whole-query substring match); no hint to shorten the query.
Unranked substring search ('prior' -> priority inversion, 'MAP' -> 30+ modules/units/study maps) forced several narrowing queries per question and opening every candidate with note-read.
No read command returns a stage working note; resume reports 'Evidence none / Open here —' while the working note holds the exact stopping point.
'related' does not surface notes that answer or correct each other; the ridge<->MAP and low-rank<->matrix-factorization links had to be found by content search and reading.
'semantic' sounded like a semantic search; it evaluates governance rule predicates.

uncertainties: Q10: whether the August matrix-factorization note counts as the learner 'having answered' the June question is her judgement; I reported the evidence and the missing link.
Q07: I did not search inbox or garden text for competing dates (content search covers durable notes only).
